description: Post hoc sensitivity of the M6d window: the registered 0.87° (Le Verrier's 52′, a heliocentric difference at 1847 January 1, Recherches p. 253) and 0.90° (his geocentric miss on Galle's night from his published elements). Built by docs/notes/scripts/m6d_window.py from the cached draws; no fit rerun.

window_52_arcmin.measures: heliocentric longitude at 1847 January 1, Galle's planet against the longitude Le Verrier published on 31 August 1846
window_52_arcmin.source: Le Verrier, Recherches sur les mouvements de la planète Herschel (1846), p. 253: 327° 24′ against 326° 32′, difference 0° 52′
